meta.title: Mario Álvarez — Data scientist specialized in sport
meta.description: Mario Álvarez, data scientist in Valencia specialized in sports analytics. Spanish madison champion and RFEC sports director.

hero.title: I was Spanish madison champion.
hero.subtitle: Now I study Data Science at UPV and analyse what sits behind performance: power, load and results. I know what a number means to a rider because I was that rider.

servicios.title: How I can help
servicios.text: I work with teams, coaches and riders who have data and want to make the most of it. And with companies that need to put theirs in order.

items.texto: I read power, load and results through a rider's eyes. I'll tell you what's going on and what I'd change.
items.prueba: Elite track rider and RFEC sports director, levels I and II.

items.texto: Scraping, models and small Python apps that answer one specific question for your team.
items.prueba: Two tools for Team Cofidis: UCI difficulty and race profile.

items.texto: Faster queries, unified databases and Power BI dashboards that make sense at first glance.
items.prueba: Over 580 tables and 100 million records in the database I'm optimising at SIME Telecom.

items.texto: Race preparation, rider follow-up and sports massage at competitions.
items.prueba: Staff with the Valencian Community regional team.

sobreMiResumen.title: From the velodrome to data
sobreMiResumen.text: I'm in my third year of the Data Science degree at UPV and I've completed a master's in digitalisation and technology applied to sport. I never left cycling: I still race on the track, I direct young riders and I work as a sports masseur with professionals.

experienciaResumen.title: Two lanes, one job
experienciaResumen.text: In one I optimise databases and build models. In the other I prepare races and follow riders. Both come down to the same thing: measure well to decide better.

ctaFinal.text: If you have performance data and unanswered questions, write to me and we'll look at it together.
